title: Unattached EBS volume
detail: 100 GiB io1, 3,000 provisioned IOPS (perf-test), not attached to any instance
recommendation: Confirm with the owner, snapshot it (cheap insurance), then delete the volume. The command waits for the snapshot to finish (up to 10 minutes); if the wait times out, delete the volume once the snapshot shows 'completed'. Delete the snapshot too after a month or two if nobody needs it.
fix_command: SNAP=$(aws ec2 create-snapshot --region ap-south-1 --volume-id vol-4d2b74392f2aca509 --description 'billdoctor: backup before delete' --query SnapshotId --output text) && aws ec2 wait snapshot-completed --region ap-south-1 --snapshot-ids "$SNAP" && aws ec2 delete-volume --region ap-south-1 --volume-id vol-4d2b74392f2aca509

recommendation: If it is not coming back: create an AMI (keeps a restorable copy), then terminate the instance. Volumes with 'delete on termination' turned off survive the termination; delete them too (the AMI holds a copy) or they show up as unattached volumes next time.

title: Previous-generation instance type
detail: t2.large -> t3.large
recommendation: Change the instance type to t3.large during a maintenance window (stop, change type, start). Newer types run on Nitro: very old AMIs need the ENA and NVMe drivers (current images have them). A stop/start changes the public IP unless it is an Elastic IP. Graviton (t4g/m7g) is cheaper still if the software runs on ARM.
fix_command: aws ec2 stop-instances --region ap-south-1 --instance-ids i-bd540e2a038f46d43 && aws ec2 wait instance-stopped --region ap-south-1 --instance-ids i-bd540e2a038f46d43 && aws ec2 modify-instance-attribute --region ap-south-1 --instance-id i-bd540e2a038f46d43 --instance-type Value=t3.large && aws ec2 start-instances --region ap-south-1 --instance-ids i-bd540e2a038f46d43

title: Bucket lifecycle gaps
detail: incomplete multipart uploads are never cleaned up; versioning is on but old versions never expire
recommendation: Add a lifecycle rule: abort incomplete multipart uploads after 7 days and expire noncurrent versions after 30-90 days.
fix_command: aws s3api put-bucket-lifecycle-configuration --region ap-south-1 --bucket acme-uploads-demo --lifecycle-configuration '{"Rules":[{"ID":"billdoctor-hygiene","Status":"Enabled","Filter":{},"AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload":{"DaysAfterInitiation":7},"NoncurrentVersionExpiration":{"NoncurrentDays":60}}]}'  # WARNING: replaces existing rules - merge them first
